description: Extension of the OnboardingView class providing asynchronous methods to manage workspace configuration, initialization, and bootstrap processes within a macOS application.

methods.name: loadWorkspaceDefaults
methods.description: Initializes workspacePath with a default workspace if it is empty, and refreshes the bootstrap status.

methods.name: ensureDefaultWorkspace
methods.description: Ensures that a default workspace is set up if the connection mode is local, setting up bootstrap safety checks and creating the workspace if needed.

methods.name: refreshBootstrapStatus
methods.description: Updates the needsBootstrap flag and resets didAutoKickoff if bootstrap is needed.

methods.name: get workspaceBootstrapCommand
methods.description: Generates a shell command string to create a directory and write a template to a markdown file for the workspace.

methods.name: applyWorkspace
methods.description: Attempts to create and set up the workspace, updating status messages accordingly.

methods.name: loadAgentWorkspace
methods.description: Loads the current workspace configuration asynchronously from persistent storage.

methods.name: saveAgentWorkspace
methods.description: Saves the workspace string asynchronously, updating status messages on failure.

methods.name: buildAndSaveWorkspace
methods.description: A static method that updates the configuration store with a new workspace value, saving it asynchronously.
